projectAndScope: A public book grown through a five-session executive programme

proposition.bookReader: A general reader responsible for decisions that AI can inform but not own
proposition.participantAudience: Mixed-function senior managers attending the programme
proposition.assumedKnowledgeBySurface: The Book assumes no organisation-design vocabulary; Teaching may build on participant experience of consequential decisions
proposition.recognisedProblem: The organisation can generate analysis faster than it can turn evidence into an accountable action
proposition.promisedChange: Readers learn to inspect the path from a noticed change to an action that can be questioned and revised
proposition.centralArgument: Faster analysis improves decisions only when evidence, judgment, authority, action, and feedback are designed together
proposition.boundary: The book does not claim that one universal workflow fits every consequential decision
proposition.evidenceBase: Verified organisational cases, primary research, clearly labelled composites, and author synthesis

architecture.carriedQuestionOrArtifact: A decision-path record revised across the book
architecture.sectionLogic: Notice, interpret, judge, commit, act, and learn
architecture.chapterPromises: Each chapter resolves one break in the path and hands the next chapter a harder design question
architecture.openingMode: A verified scene followed by enough context for a novice to enter it
architecture.programmeTablePlacement: Interactive programme shell only; omitted from the public Book reading flow

titleSystems.name: Decision Path
titleSystems.title: The Decision Path
titleSystems.subtitle: How Organisations Turn AI Analysis into Accountable Action
titleSystems.promise: A direct category title for the practical route the reader learns to inspect
titleSystems.tradeOff: Clearer than provocative; relies on the subtitle for the AI context
titleSystems.coverConnection: A broken route becoming a continuous but revisable line

titleSystems.name: What the Dashboard Cannot Decide
titleSystems.title: What the Dashboard Cannot Decide
titleSystems.subtitle: Judgment, Authority, and Action in the Age of AI
titleSystems.promise: Begins from a familiar object and exposes the organisational work left unresolved
titleSystems.tradeOff: More distinctive but narrower if the book later moves beyond dashboard-mediated decisions
titleSystems.coverConnection: A precise display whose edge opens into several human routes

authorAndFrontMatter.authorNoteJob: Explain the author's vantage and why this decision problem deserves a book now
authorAndFrontMatter.sourceBoundary: No biography, thanks, endorsement, client, or link is inferred from the programme brief

voiceContract.paragraphMovement: Each paragraph changes the explanation and gives the next paragraph a live consequence
voiceContract.exampleStandard: One sustained case and bounded lateral examples with distinct jobs, verified facts, boundaries, and human returns
voiceContract.densityAndHumour: Substantive and direct, with humour only when it exposes a system more cleanly
voiceContract.vocabularyPolicy: Introduce specialist terms through a problem, plain definition, nearby distinction, and consequential reuse
voiceContract.emphasisPolicy: Book prose may use sparse semantic italics; display emphasis remains rare

directions.name: Revisable Route
directions.premiseConnection: Shows a decision moving while retaining visible branches and reversals
directions.composition: One route crosses the cover, branches once, and reconnects beneath the title
directions.paletteRoles: Warm paper ground, dark ink structure, one signal colour for a changed state
directions.typographyMood: Editorial serif with restrained technical annotations
directions.figureGrammar: Plain causal paths and state changes, never decorative cards
directions.prohibitedMotifs: Robots, glowing brains, circuit faces, generic dashboards
directions.differenceFromRecentWork: Route-led geometry rather than a centred emblem or mineral texture

directions.name: Incomplete Record
directions.premiseConnection: Makes the missing and acquired parts of a record visible
directions.composition: A ledger-like field with one absent line and one intrusive trace
directions.paletteRoles: Pale neutral field, near-black type, two restrained evidence marks with different jobs
directions.typographyMood: Modern book typography with archival restraint
directions.figureGrammar: Evidence marks, omissions, and annotations tied to source status
directions.prohibitedMotifs: Neon AI gradients, corporate stock photography, repeated colour-coded panels
directions.differenceFromRecentWork: Evidence-object cover rather than a route or illustrated scene

exerciseDirection.caseMode: A common bounded case followed by learner-owned transfer
exerciseDirection.observableArtifact: A decision-path record with comparable fields
exerciseDirection.commitmentRule: The reader answers the required fields before AI or a worked edition appears
exerciseDirection.revealRule: A consequential fact or comparison becomes available only after commitment
exerciseDirection.workedComparisonJob: Show one defensible completed artifact field for field, not prescribe the correct answer

deferred: Final jacket copy may be written after the full manuscript exists

approval.evidence: Explicit approval recorded in the project conversation
